get.description:
Lists videos and Shorts from a Rumble channel. Required input: `url`. Results are paged: while `data.page.hasMore` is true, send `data.page.nextCursor` as `cursor` to get the next page.

> **Request example pending verification.** The request example for this endpoint has not yet been verified in production. Static examples describe the request format; replace sample values with your own. Check the estimated price with a free quote request (`X-AISA-Cost-Mode: quote`) before running it.

schema.description: Page number from a previous response.

aisa_pagination.description: AIsa pagination. Pass next_cursor as cursor to fetch the next page; has_more is false on the last page.

X-AISA-Next-Cursor.description: Mirrors aisa_pagination.next_cursor; absent on the last page.
